spec.title: Up
spec.description: 1 when the Alloy self target is scraped successfully, 0 when down.

spec.title: Components
spec.description: Number of components currently running in the Alloy controller.

spec.title: Config Load OK
spec.description: 1 when the last configuration load succeeded, 0 when it failed.

spec.title: Config Failures
spec.description: Total configuration load failures since Alloy started.

spec.title: Evaluation p99
spec.description: 99th percentile component evaluation duration.

spec.title: Dependencies wait p99
spec.description: 99th percentile time components spend waiting on their dependencies.

spec.title: Evaluation Queue
spec.description: Components queued for evaluation in the controller.

spec.title: Evaluating
spec.description: Components currently being evaluated.

spec.title: Memory (RSS)
spec.description: Resident memory used by the Alloy process.

spec.title: Virtual Memory
spec.description: Virtual memory used by the Alloy process.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU cores used by Alloy.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the Alloy process started.

spec.title: Network RX/s
spec.description: Bytes received per second by the Alloy host.

spec.title: Network TX/s
spec.description: Bytes transmitted per second by the Alloy host.

spec.title: Global Label IDs
spec.description: Global label IDs tracked in the label store.

spec.title: Remote Store IDs
spec.description: Remote-store label IDs tracked in the label store.

spec.title: Evaluation p99
spec.description: Component evaluation duration over time.

spec.description: Dependency wait time over time.

spec.title: Memory (RSS)
spec.description: Alloy resident memory over time.

spec.title: CPU
